definitions.ask: Should the menu row for the inherited theme say it is the current default?
definitions.why: It answers "why didn't that write?" before Enter, with no write-path risk.

choices.label: The inherited theme's row gets a Default badge and "inherited from area note job"
Leave rows unmarked; only the toast explains why nothing was written

definitions.ask: Should the Task Card header's Theme pill also show uncolored themes such as PLAN in grey?
definitions.why: The header and the menu sit on the same card, so PLAN should look the same in both.

choices.label: The header pill and the menu rows both show uncolored themes in the same grey
Only the menu rows turn grey; the header pill keeps its hollow muted swatch
